title: Coast Guard rescues 3 after boat capsizes off Bodega Bay
description: The Coast Guard rescued three people, Nov. 9, 2019, after a 54-foot commercial fishing boat, Miss Hailee, capsized approximately 30 miles northwest of Bodega Bay. A Coast Guard Air Station San Francisco MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew arrived on scene and hoisted three people into the helicopter, where the rescued members informed Coast Guard personnel that a fourth person was missing, prompting a search for the missing man that lasted until the following morning. (U.S. Coast Guard video)
